text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno, you don't seem very cheery
today. Is
something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
N-no. You're mistaken. I am completely
myself.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm not so sure... I could've sworn you
were eating
less than normal today.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Urk... The truth is, I had a dream last
night about
my grandparents. And now I
cannot stop thinking
of my family...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
How shameful! Becoming sentimental is
the surest
sign of a weak mind! I must
train more diligently!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing to be ashamed of. I think
about
my home a lot.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oguri's right about that. It's natural to
want to
see your beloved family again.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We're here for you if you ever want to
talk about
it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm very grateful to both of you.
Speaking about
it has brought some
peace to my mind.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Good. Then you should be ready for a
proper
meal. Luckily for us, the
restaurant in front of the
station is
offering free upgrades to extra large

right now.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Don't hesitate to let us know if anything
else ever
troubles you. Just think of me
as your mama.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That... would perhaps be a little
strange... Hehe,
but I feel fortunate
nonetheless.
